title: AI Pastel Art Generator
summary: Make pastel art with AI: soft chalk pastel, oil pastel and pastel colour drawings with real paper grain. Describe it, pick a pastel style, and Flick draws it.
body_markdown:
### How do I make pastel art with AI?


Describe the subject, the kind of pastel, how the strokes are blended and the paper, such as a soft pastel lavender field with a finger-blended sky on sanded paper, then pick a pastel style and generate. In Flick you can then animate the drawing into a clip.


### Can AI turn a photo into a pastel drawing?


Yes. Add the photo as a reference image and ask for a soft pastel or oil pastel drawing of it, naming the strokes and the paper and keeping the same pose and framing.


### How do I make AI pastel art look real?


Ask for the marks a real pastel leaves: visible directional strokes, paper grain showing through, some areas blended and some left raw, and a coloured paper such as grey, buff or black. A fully smooth image reads as digital painting.


### Can I make a pastel style video?


Yes. Generate the drawing first, then use it as the start frame of an image to video model in Flick and describe a gentle motion, such as wind moving through the lavender, while asking to keep the chalky texture.


### Is the pastel art generator free?


Yes, it is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every week with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6 runs on it. Video models such as Seedance 2.5 need the Standard plan ($20 a month).
